author: touropia
description:
Europe is often defined by its history, but its landscapes tell a story that began long before the first cities appeared.

Over millions of years, powerful natural forces have shaped the continent into a place of remarkable contrasts. Some landscapes feel almost untouched, while others reveal the immense geological forces still at work beneath the surface.

And despite Europe’s relatively small size, its natural scenery changes dramatically from one region to the next. From the Arctic north to the shores of the Mediterranean, there are places that seem to belong to entirely different worlds.

Together, they reveal a side of Europe that feels older, wilder, and far more dramatic than many people imagine.
title: 25 Greatest Natural Wonders of Europe - Travel Video
